'''Rēzeknes Futbola Akadēmija/Bērnu un jauniešu sporta skola''' ({{langx|en|Football Academy of Rēzekne/Children and Youth Sports school}}) is a [[Latvia]]n football club based in [[Rēzekne]]. They compete in the second-highest division of Latvian football ([[Latvian First League|1. līga]]) and the [[Latvian Football Cup]].<ref name="soccerway">{{cite web|url=https://int.soccerway.com/teams/latvia/fk-rzeknebjss/18419/|title=Latvia – FK Rēzekne / BJSS – Results, fixtures, squad, statistics, photos, videos and news – Soccerway|publisher=uk.soccerway.com|accessdate=2015-02-18}}</ref>"}}
